narr: A very small but stationary cluster of thunderstorms sat over the same area during the early morning hours. Isolated flash flooding occurred under this cluster. These storms were associated with a weak cold front that extended from Lake Michigan down into southeast Illinois.
ev: Significant flash flooding was reported across the western side of Franklin County. Water was over Route 14 in multiple locations west of Christopher. Water was over Route 184 in multiple locations north and south of Mulkeytown. Many rural roads were completely impassable. A Cocorahs observer at Christopher measured 5.11 inches of rain over 48 hours.
